text:
infra-bot: [ALERT] provisioner-heartbeat anomalies in eu-central-2 — multiple GPU nodes flapping, health checks failing
alex: seeing p95 gen latency spike in eu-central, queues growing. noticed a lot of batcher backpressure :grimacing:
priya: confirmed. p50 -> 600ms, p95 -> 4.9s for text-gen. KV cache miss rate jumped from 8% -> 65% in last 10m
matt: grabbing logs now. last deploy touched provisioner heartbeat tuning (10s -> 60s) earlier today. suspect regression
sarah: `kubectl get pods -n infra-provisioner -o wide` shows 5/12 pods in CrashLoopBackOff or NotReady
sarah: snippet:
```
provisioner-7f8b9   0/1     CrashLoopBackOff  3   2m
provisioner-9c3d2   0/1     CrashLoopBackOff  5   7m
provisioner-a2c1e   1/1     Running          12d
```
diego: we have a hotpool shortage for GPU T4s in eu-central-2; autoscaler backlog increasing
alex: immediate mitigation: start draining non-critical traffic from eu-central to na1 and na2 for gen endpoints. will keep enterprise routes pinned to eu for compliance
oncall: applying routing rule now — shifting 40% of standard API traffic off eu-central (rollout id r-2026-03-20-01)
matt: rolling restart of provisioner deployment to pick up rollback patch `kubectl rollout restart deployment/provisioner -n infra-provisioner` — doing canary first (2 pods)
deploy-bot: Canaries healthy after restart (2/2). Monitoring for heartbeat stability
priya: while we restart, launching KV-cache prewarm job for top 50 prefixes to reduce cold miss amplification
priya: command run:
```
python tools/prewarm_kv.py --region eu-central-2 --prefix-file /tmp/top50.txt --parallel 8
```
alex: also temporarily lowering batcher max_batch_wait from 15ms -> 8ms in eu to reduce tail latency (trade CPU for latency)
matt: observed provisioner metrics — heartbeat success rate improved after canary. will continue rolling restart across remaining replicas
diego: scaled hotpool +20% for eu-central (manual) to cover immediate capacity gap. watching cost impact but necessary
oncall: traffic shift + prewarm + restarts reduced p95 from 4.9s -> 1.1s in 12 minutes. KV miss rate down to 22%
alex: follow-up plan: revert heartbeat change in config repo, add integration test to catch heartbeat regressions, add alert for KV miss amplification
matt: opened PR #2764 to pin heartbeat to 10s and include e2e check; will schedule emergency patch release
sarah: filing incident ticket INC-2026-0319-01 with timeline and mitigations
alex: postmortem owners: matt (root cause & rollback), priya (kv prewarm & cache hardening), diego (capacity + autoscaler tuning)
oncall: closing on call — will leave expanded monitoring on for 48h and run a synthetic traffic sweep tonight
deploy-bot: patch release deployed to eu-central canary at 2319999400, full rollout at 2319999520
alex: tl;dr: heartbeat regression from recent provisioner change caused nodes to be marked unhealthy -> hotpool shortage -> batcher backpressure + KV cold misses -> latency spike. Mitigations: route shift, hotpool scale, provisioner restart + config rollback, KV prewarm, batcher tuning. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: incident closed to P2 at 2319999555 — monitoring only.
